title: The Scholar's Tower
text: Books crowd this tower to the rafters, mouldering, stacked on the stairs. A scholar too old to leave lives among them, thin as a quill and ink-stained to the elbow. He offers to teach one of you anything in exchange for news of the world; he has not seen anyone in a very long time.

options.label: The most curious learns from him while he still has the breath to teach.

outcomes.text: They take a week's lessons in a night, their head too full to sleep after.

options.label: Tell him everything of the world; he is lonely, and it costs nothing.

outcomes.text: He listens like a child and gives you a map in thanks.

options.label: The Leader takes the rarest books; they are wasted on a dying man.

outcomes.text: He weeps but does not stop you. You can hear him for a long way.
